KUN AALBORG. Log pris og VIF. Prevent aliased coefficients
```{r}
#Klargør data og behold både Pris_Salg og Log_Pris_Salg
homedata_aalborg <- homedata %>%
  filter(KommuneNavn == "Aalborg")

homedata3 <- homedata_aalborg %>%
  mutate(Log_Pris_Salg = log(Pris_Salg)) %>%
  select(EjdType, Pris_Salg, Log_Pris_Salg, Areal_Bolig, 
         Areal_GarageCarport, Areal_Grund, Areal_Kaelder, Ejd_Altan, Ejd_AntalPlan, 
         Ejd_AntalRum, Ejd_AntalSoveVaerelser, Ejd_AntalToiletter, Ejd_Energimaerke, Ejd_Opfoerelsesaar, 
         Alder, Salgsaar, Dist_skole, Dist_raadhus, Afstemningsomraade, corona)

# Korrekt konvertering af faktorer direkte på homedata1
homedata3$EjdType <- as.factor(homedata3$EjdType)
homedata3$Afstemningsomraade <- as.factor(homedata3$Afstemningsomraade)
homedata3$Ejd_Energimaerke <- as.factor(homedata3$Ejd_Energimaerke)

homedata3_clean <- na.omit(homedata3)

# Uden logaritme (Husk at ekskludere Log_Pris_Salg fra prediktorerne)
model_pris3 <- lm(Pris_Salg ~ . - Log_Pris_Salg, data = homedata3_clean)

# Med logaritme (Husk at ekskludere den oprindelige Pris_Salg)
model_log3 <- lm(Log_Pris_Salg ~ . - Pris_Salg, data = homedata3_clean)


# Plot 1: Uden log
plot(fitted(model_pris3), resid(model_pris3), 
     xlab = "Fitted Values (Price)", 
     ylab = "Residuals", 
     main = "Normal Price")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Plot 2: Med log 
plot(fitted(model_log3), resid(model_log3), 
     xlab = "Fitted Values (Log_price)", 
     ylab = "Residuals", 
     main = "Log Price")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

vif(model_log3)

summary(model_log3)
```



Undersøger forholdet mellem Dist_raadhus og Afstmeningsomraader. Meget høj korrelation mellem Afstemningomraade om Dist_raadhus

Model UDEN afstmeningsomraade (UA).
```{r}
#Klargør data og behold både Pris_Salg og Log_Pris_Salg
homedata_aalborg <- homedata %>%
  filter(KommuneNavn == "Aalborg")

homedata_UA <- homedata_aalborg %>%
  mutate(Log_Pris_Salg = log(Pris_Salg)) %>%
  select(EjdType, Pris_Salg, Log_Pris_Salg, Areal_Bolig, 
         Areal_GarageCarport, Areal_Grund, Areal_Kaelder, Ejd_Altan, Ejd_AntalPlan, 
         Ejd_AntalRum, Ejd_AntalSoveVaerelser, Ejd_AntalToiletter, Ejd_Energimaerke, Ejd_Opfoerelsesaar, 
         Alder, Salgsaar, Dist_skole, Dist_raadhus, corona)

# Korrekt konvertering af faktorer direkte på homedata1
homedata_UA$EjdType <- as.factor(homedata_UA$EjdType)
homedata_UA$Ejd_Energimaerke <- as.factor(homedata_UA$Ejd_Energimaerke)

homedata_UA_clean <- na.omit(homedata_UA)

# Uden logaritme (Husk at ekskludere Log_Pris_Salg fra prediktorerne)
model_pris_UA <- lm(Pris_Salg ~ . - Log_Pris_Salg, data = homedata_UA_clean)

# Med logaritme (Husk at ekskludere den oprindelige Pris_Salg)
model_log_UA <- lm(Log_Pris_Salg ~ . - Pris_Salg, data = homedata_UA_clean)

# Plot 1: Uden log
plot(fitted(model_pris_UA), resid(model_pris_UA), 
     xlab = "Fitted Values (Price)", 
     ylab = "Residuals", 
     main = "Normal Price")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Plot 2: Med log 
plot(fitted(model_log_UA), resid(model_log_UA), 
     xlab = "Fitted Values (Log_price)", 
     ylab = "Residuals", 
     main = "Log Price")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

vif(model_log_UA)
```

```{r}
# Korrekt konvertering af faktorer direkte på homedata1
homedata_UDR$EjdType <- as.factor(homedata_UDR$EjdType)
homedata_UDR$Ejd_Energimaerke <- as.factor(homedata_UDR$Ejd_Energimaerke)
homedata_UDR$Afstemningsomraade <- as.factor(homedata_UDR$Afstemningsomraade)

homedata_UDR_clean <- na.omit(homedata_UA)

# Uden logaritme (Husk at ekskludere Log_Pris_Salg fra prediktorerne)
model_pris_UDR <- lm(Pris_Salg ~ . - Log_Pris_Salg, data = homedata_UDR_clean)

# Med logaritme (Husk at ekskludere den oprindelige Pris_Salg)
model_log_UDR <- lm(Log_Pris_Salg ~ . - Pris_Salg, data = homedata_UDR_clean)

# Plot 1: Uden log
plot(fitted(model_pris_UDR), resid(model_pris_UDR),

     main = "Normal Price")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Plot 2: Med log 
plot(fitted(model_log_UDR), resid(model_log_UDR), 
     xlab = "Fitted Values (Log_price)", 
     ylab = "Residuals", 
     main = "Log Price")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

vif(model_log_UDR)
```

Undersøger om UA og UDR er ens
```{r}
# Sammenlign R-squared
summary(model_log_UA)$r.squared
summary(model_log_UDR)$r.squared

# Sammenlign residualernes sum af kvadrater
deviance(model_log_UA)
deviance(model_log_UDR)

# Sammenlign de forudsagte værdier
all.equal(
  fitted(model_log_UA),
  fitted(model_log_UDR)
)

# Sammenlign residualerne
all.equal(
  residuals(model_log_UA),
  residuals(model_log_UDR)
)
```

Laver ny model uden Corona, AntalRum, AntalPlan, Altan. (Kun meget lidt dårligere) 
```{r}
homedata_prime <- homedata_aalborg %>%
  mutate(Log_Pris_Salg = log(Pris_Salg)) %>%
  select(EjdType, Pris_Salg, Log_Pris_Salg, Areal_Bolig, 
         Areal_GarageCarport, Areal_Grund, Areal_Kaelder, 
         Ejd_AntalSoveVaerelser, Ejd_Energimaerke, Ejd_Opfoerelsesaar, 
         Alder, Salgsaar, Dist_skole, Afstemningsomraade)

# Korrekt konvertering af faktorer direkte på homedata1
homedata_prime$EjdType <- as.factor(homedata_prime$EjdType)
homedata_prime$Ejd_Energimaerke <- as.factor(homedata_prime$Ejd_Energimaerke)
homedata_prime$Afstemningsomraade <- as.factor(homedata_prime$Afstemningsomraade)

homedata_prime_clean <- na.omit(homedata_prime)

model_log_prime <- lm(Log_Pris_Salg ~ . - Pris_Salg, data = homedata_prime_clean)
summary(model_log_prime)
```
Under om Designmatricen er fuld rank og n>p
```{r}
vif(model_log_prime)
X <- model.matrix(model_log_prime)
qr(X)$rank
ncol(X)

n <- nrow(X)
p <- ncol(X)
n>p

```






Cross-Validation

Repeated Cross-validation for model_log_opti
```{r}
train_control2 <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv", number=10, repeats = 3)
model2 <- train(
  formula(model_log_opti),
  data = homedata_opti_clean,
  method = "lm",
  trControl = train_control2
)
print(model2)
```




Repeated Cross-validation for model_log_prime (stort set ingen forskel)
```{r}
train_control3 <- trainControl(method="repeatedcv", number=10, repeats = 3)
model3 <- train(
  formula(model_log_prime),
  data = homedata_prime_clean,
  method = "lm",
  trControl = train_control3
)
print(model3)
```



Residual analyzes (Diagnostic plots)

```{r}
stud_res <- rstudent(model_log_prime)

plot(homedata_prime_clean$Log_Pris_Salg, stud_res, ylab="Studentized Residuals", xlab="Log_Pris" )
abline(h=c(-2,2))
```


```{r}
plot(fitted(model_log_prime), rstudent(model_log_prime),
     main = "Studentized Residuals vs Fitted",
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Studentized Residuals")


abline(h = c(-2, 2), col = "grey50", lty = 2)

plot(fitted(model_log_prime), rstandard(model_log_prime),
     main = "Standard Residuals vs Fitted",
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Standard Residuals")


abline(h = c(-2, 2), col = "grey50", lty = 2)
```

Ny model uden række 24
```{r}
homedata_prime_clean2 <- homedata_prime_clean[-24, ]
model_log_prime2 <- lm(Log_Pris_Salg ~ . - Pris_Salg, data = homedata_prime_clean2)
summary(model_log_prime2)
```



```{r}
residuals_prime2 <- residuals(model_log_prime2)

qqnorm(residuals_prime2,
       main = "Normal Q-Q Plot of Residuals UA",
       xlab = "Theoretical Quantiles",
       ylab = "Sample Quantiles")

qqline(residuals_prime2, col = "grey50", lwd = 2)



hist(residuals_prime2, prob = TRUE, main = "Distribution of Residuals", xlab = "Residuals", col = "lightblue")
curve(dnorm(x, mean = mean(residuals_prime2), sd = sd(residuals_prime2)), add = TRUE, col = "red", lwd = 2)

```
```{r}
#Verifies Homoscedasticity
sqrt_abs_residuals <- sqrt(abs(residuals_prime2))
plot(fitted(model_log_prime2),sqrt_abs_residuals,
xlab="Fitted values",
ylab="Square Root of Absolute Residuals",
main="Scale-Location Plot"
)
lines(smooth.spline(fitted(model_log_prime2),sqrt_abs_residuals),col="red", lwd=2)
```
(Kan man zoom ud og vise cooks distance mere tydelig?)
```{r}
plot(hatvalues(model_log_prime2), rstandard(model_log_prime2),
     xlab = "Leverage",
     ylab = "Standardized residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Leverage")

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Inkluder cooks disatnce



# Plot Residuals vs. Leverage with Cook's distance contours
plot(model_log_prime2, which = 5)

# Inspect exact values programmatically
lev <- hatvalues(model_log_prime2)
std_res <- rstandard(model_log_prime2)
cook_d <- cooks.distance(model_log_prime2)

# Flag observations with Cook's distance > 0.5
which(cook_d > 0.5)
```


Leverage (Hvordan laver man de plots på side 59 i noterne?)
```{r}
n <- nobs(model_log_prime2)
p <- length(coef(model_log_prime2))

#Average
threshold_Leverage2 <- 2*p/n

hats2 <- data.frame(
  observation2 = 1:length(hatvalues(model_log_prime2)),
  leverage2 = hatvalues(model_log_prime2)
)

hats_sorted2 <- hats2[order(-hats2$leverage2), ]
high_leverage2 <- hats_sorted2[
  hats_sorted2$leverage2 > threshold_Leverage2, 
]

# Udtræk observationsnumrene
high_leverage_rows2 <- high_leverage2$observation2
high_leverage_data2 <- homedata_opti[high_leverage_rows2, ]
high_leverage_data2 <- cbind(Leverage2 = high_leverage2$leverage2, high_leverage_data2)
high_leverage_data2
```

Adjusted for inflation (Dårliger?)
```{r}
CPI <- data.frame(
  Salgsaar = c(2011,2012, 2013, 2014,2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022),
  cpi = c(79.2,81.1375,81.21916667,81.3025, 81.36666667, 81.4175, 81.47583333, 81.53583333, 81.58, 81.605, 81.63583333, 81.6783333)
)

homedata_aalborg2 <- homedata_aalborg %>%
  left_join(CPI, by="Salgsaar")

CPI_basis <- CPI$cpi[CPI$Salgsaar==2022]

homedata_inflation <- homedata_aalborg2 %>%
  mutate(Realpris=Pris_Salg*CPI_basis/cpi)

```

```{r}
homedata_inflation <- homedata_inflation %>%
  mutate(Log_PrisI_Salg = log(Realpris)) %>%
  select(EjdType, Realpris, Log_PrisI_Salg, Areal_Bolig, 
         Areal_GarageCarport, Areal_Grund, Areal_Kaelder, 
          Ejd_AntalSoveVaerelser, Ejd_Energimaerke, Ejd_Opfoerelsesaar, 
         Alder, Salgsaar, Dist_skole, Afstemningsomraade)

# Korrekt konvertering af faktorer direkte på homedata1
homedata_inflation$EjdType <- as.factor(homedata_inflation$EjdType)
homedata_inflation$Ejd_Energimaerke <- as.factor(homedata_inflation$Ejd_Energimaerke)
homedata_inflation$Afstemningsomraade <- as.factor(homedata_inflation$Afstemningsomraade)

homedata_inflation_clean <- na.omit(homedata_inflation)

# Med logaritme (Husk at ekskludere den oprindelige Pris_Salg)
model_log_inflation <- lm(Log_PrisI_Salg ~ . - Realpris, data = homedata_inflation_clean)

summary(model_log_inflation)
```

Repeated Cross-validation for model_log_inflation
```{r}

model5 <- train(
  formula(model_log_inflation),

  trControl = train_control5
)
print(model5)
```
